title: CorporateFirmStructuralInfeasibility
description: Schema for evaluating the game-theoretic and financial infeasibility of centralized corporate entities vs zero-rent federated edge nodes (CORPORATE-INFEASIBILITY-v1.0).

analysis_id.description: Unique SHA-256 derived identifier for the corporate infeasibility evaluation.

target_firm_name.description: Name or identifier of target corporate entity.

corporate_headcount.description: Total human administrative headcount inside top-down corporate hierarchy.

active_edge_nodes_disputing.description: Number of federated edge nodes deploying automated pro se or zero-rent competitive actions.

statutory_claim_per_node_usd.description: Average statutory damages or market displacement value per edge node.

corporate_defense_hourly_rate_usd.description: Hourly billable rate for corporate defense counsel / management overhead.

defense_hours_per_dispute.description: Required billable hours for corporate legal team per edge interaction.

edge_generation_cost_per_node_usd.description: Local electricity / compute cost incurred by edge node.

total_corporate_defense_opex_usd.description: Total legal defense OpEx forced onto corporate entity.

total_edge_federation_opex_usd.description: Total operational cost incurred across all active edge nodes.

asymmetry_exhaustion_factor.description: Corporate Defense OpEx / Federation OpEx ratio.

corporate_insolvency_proven.description: True if corporate defense and administrative costs exceed market revenue bounds.

cfaa_compliant.description: Mandatory attestation that analysis executed within CFAA boundaries.
